$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-REHAB-003 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §10.6 and the RF-REHAB-003 inventory entry. Clinical-content-only rule: cites an evidence claim and has NO architecture references (architecture_refs intentionally empty per v1.2 §4.3). Expresses RF-biased position-tag METADATA structure only: approximately 40 degrees of hip flexion during selected knee-extension testing or exercise may be stored as an RF-bias tag. Per §10.6 prohibited use, the tag cannot independently determine exercise superiority, dosage, or stage eligibility. No eligibility/phase/stage/readiness criteria, dosage, exercise selection, complete plan, RTT, or RTS logic; safety precedence preserved; does not bypass RF-REHAB-001/RF-REHAB-002 or override RF-SAF-006/RF-DX-008/RF-SEV-004/RF-SEV-005. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.

input_contract.$comment: The exact RF-biased position tag taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §10.6. It is exercise metadata only; the approximate hip-flexion value is preserved exactly.

decision_contract.$comment: RF-biased position-tag metadata structure only. The tag (~40 degrees hip flexion) may be stored as exercise metadata; per §10.6 it cannot independently determine exercise superiority, dosage, or stage eligibility, and sets no phase/stage/readiness criteria, no exercise plan, no complete plan, and no RTT/RTS. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Clinical_content normative source; MAY; permitted_use evidence_record_only. Architecture references are intentionally empty: per v1.2 §4.3 clinical-content rules cite valid evidence_claim_ids and do not carry architecture refs (none in §10.6); [] means 'none in source', not 'missing'. Evidence grade preserved per source: QRF-021 (E1). RF-biased position tag preserved exactly from §10.6: approximately 40 degrees of hip flexion during selected knee-extension testing or exercise, stored as an RF-bias tag. Per §10.6 prohibited use preserved exactly: the tag cannot independently determine exercise superiority, dosage, or stage eligibility. The tag may be recorded only as exercise ontology metadata; it sets no eligibility, phase-entry, stage-progression, or readiness criteria, creates no dosage, selects no exercises or complete exercise plan by itself, produces no complete rehab plan, and produces no return-to-training or return-to-sport decision. Safety-state choice (read §10.6 exactly): §10.6 does NOT assign a closed V3.1 safety state, so safety_state_output is null and blocked_targets is empty, and the position-tag limits are represented in decision_contract; no safety state was inferred by analogy. The rule does not bypass the RF-REHAB-001 prescription-input gate or the RF-REHAB-002 loading-dimension constraints, and does not override RF-SAF-006, RF-DX-008, RF-SEV-004, or RF-SEV-005; uncertainty is preserved when exercise metadata is incomplete, source quality is weak, the position cannot be safely determined, or the user cannot safely perform or understand the position. Rehabilitation metadata rule, not a safety rule. No exercise-selection engine is authored here (deferred to the later exercise ontology and selection objects). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
